SELECT
    internal_id AS ticket_id,
    external_id,
    subject,
    category,
    priority,
    status,
    assigned_team,
    assigned_to,
    requester_email,
    sla_due_at,
    sla_warning_sent_at,
    escalated_at
FROM tickets
WHERE status IN ('open', 'in_progress')
  AND sla_due_at > NOW()
  AND sla_due_at <= NOW() + INTERVAL '30 minutes'
  AND sla_warning_sent_at IS NULL
ORDER BY sla_due_at ASC;

WITH updated_ticket AS (
    UPDATE tickets
    SET sla_warning_sent_at = NOW(),
        updated_at = NOW()
    WHERE internal_id = {{ $('If').item.json.ticket_id }}
      AND sla_warning_sent_at IS NULL
    RETURNING
        internal_id AS ticket_id,
        external_id,
        subject,
        category,
        priority,
        status,
        assigned_team,
        assigned_to,
        requester_email,
        sla_due_at,
        sla_warning_sent_at
),

insert_ticket_log AS (
    INSERT INTO ticket_logs (
        ticket_id,
        action,
        actor_type,
        message
    )
    SELECT
        ticket_id,
        'sla_warning_sent',
        'system',
        'SLA warning sent before due time.'
    FROM updated_ticket
    RETURNING ticket_id
),

insert_workflow_log AS (
    INSERT INTO workflow_logs (
        workflow_name,
        ticket_id,
        step_name,
        status,
        wf_message
    )
    SELECT
        '{{ $workflow.name }}',
        ticket_id,
        'sla_warning_sent',
        'success',
        'SLA warning notification sent.'
    FROM updated_ticket
    RETURNING ticket_id
)

SELECT
    ticket_id,
    external_id,
    subject,
    category,
    priority,
    status,
    assigned_team,
    assigned_to,
    requester_email,
    sla_due_at,
    sla_warning_sent_at
FROM updated_ticket;

SELECT
    internal_id AS ticket_id,
    external_id,
    subject,
    category,
    priority,
    status,
    assigned_team,
    assigned_to,
    requester_email,
    sla_due_at,
    sla_warning_sent_at,
    escalated_at
FROM tickets
WHERE status IN ('open')
  AND sla_due_at <= NOW()
  AND escalated_at IS NULL
ORDER BY sla_due_at ASC;

WITH updated_ticket AS (
    UPDATE tickets
    SET status = 'escalated',
        escalated_at = NOW(),
        updated_at = NOW()
    WHERE internal_id = {{ $json.ticket_id }}
      AND status IN ('open', 'in_progress')
      AND escalated_at IS NULL
    RETURNING
        internal_id AS ticket_id,
        external_id,
        subject,
        category,
        priority,
        status,
        assigned_team,
        assigned_to,
        requester_email,
        sla_due_at,
        escalated_at
),

insert_ticket_log AS (
    INSERT INTO ticket_logs (
        ticket_id,
        action,
        old_value,
        new_value,
        actor_type,
        message
    )
    SELECT
        ticket_id,
        'status_changed',
        'open',
        'escalated',
        'system',
        'Ticket escalated because SLA was breached.'
    FROM updated_ticket
    RETURNING ticket_id
),

insert_workflow_log AS (
    INSERT INTO workflow_logs (
        workflow_name,
        ticket_id,
        step_name,
        status,
        wf_message
    )
    SELECT
        '{{ $workflow.name }}',
        ticket_id,
        'sla_breach_detected',
        'success',
        'SLA breached. Ticket escalated.'
    FROM updated_ticket
    RETURNING ticket_id
)

SELECT
    ticket_id,
    external_id,
    subject,
    category,
    priority,
    status,

    assigned_to,
    requester_email,
    sla_due_at,
    escalated_at
FROM updated_ticket;
